criteria.criterion: Every selected image and ARM compatibility profile has a component inventory tied to its immutable bundle and original input-manifest hash, with a source/licence disposition per component, including embedded/vendored dependencies.

The 17 missing declarations and special inputs above have source-cited dispositions and retained exact notices; no recipe-header licence is substituted for the shipped third-party work's licence. Any required product change has its own rebuilt/requalified artifact before release.

A fork-owned corresponding-source bundle retains exact fetched source archives/git/submodules, fork patches and build scripts, with machine-readable hashes and a complete component-to-member map. Prebuilt rclone/ABL/shareware assets and Nix inputs are explicitly assessed rather than silently counted as source.

Independent retrieval and hash verification of the source bundle pass, and the required backup custody is evidenced; local source-cache existence and public repository visibility alone do not close this criterion.

#344, M7, the release manifest/notes and canonical checkpoint link the final inventory, bundle and any remaining physical/publication gates. Publication is not claimed while an unresolved disposition remains.

Exact upstream commit/tag/archive hashes and Linux/native/submodule/file-change review are recorded, with every retained fork patch applying and no silent loss of whole-library preparation, opt-in behavior, saved state or offline queue behavior.
